expected_issues.title: Security/consistency: `isFileUriValid` only checks that the URI string starts with the au…
expected_issues.description: Security/consistency: `isFileUriValid` only checks that the URI string starts with the authorized base path. Ensure the URI is normalized/canonical before comparison to avoid path trickery (e.g., encoded `..` segments or mixed casing/encoding). At minimum, consider comparing `path.normalize()` and building the base using `URI` path components rather than raw string concatenation.
